description: Sets the details Janusz needs to fill in the documents of a tender in 'Moje przetargi' — the completion deadline, the signatory's name and role, and the VAT rate of the offer price — as the user stated them (the same details the Janusz chat in the app records). Only the given fields change. Returns what is still missing before start_fill; the offer price is set with confirm_bid_price. Requires OAuth authentication and a trial or paid plan.

completion_deadline.description: e.g. '30 dni od podpisania umowy' or '2026-12-15'

signatory_name.description: full name of the person signing the offer

vat_rate.description: VAT rate of the offer price (confirm_bid_price is net): 23, 8, 5, 0 or zw (VAT-exempt). Janusz computes the gross price from it; without it he assumes 23.

name: set_fill_details
title: Ustaw dane do wypełnienia
